Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1001068" [decision]: The feature-flags service was owned by the Ember team as of 2025-11-06, having moved from the Atlas team, until ownership transferred to the Dune team on 2026-02-11.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags, Dune team, Ember team)
- memory_id "1001061": The feature-flags service was owned by the Ember team from 2025-11-06, having moved from the Atlas team, until ownership transferred to the Dune team on 2026-02-11.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags, Dune team, Ember team)
- memory_id "1001048": On 2026-02-10 the Boreal team noticed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, indexer)
- memory_id "1000986": On 2025-12-31 the Atlas team noticed that the feature-flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send and flagged it because it is not their service.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000979": On 2025-12-29 the Dune team observed that the event bus' request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: Dune team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000973": On 2025-12-25 the Atlas team noticed that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and flagged it because it is not their service.  (about: Atlas team, reports pipeline)
- memory_id "1000952" [decision]: On 2025-12-18 the Atlas team decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every product catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes.  (about: Atlas team, product catalog, indexer)
- memory_id "1000907": On 2025-12-01 the Boreal team flagged the job scheduler's cold start regression because the job scheduler is not their service.  (about: Boreal team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000900": On 2025-12-01 the Boreal team noticed that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: Boreal team, billing API)
- memory_id "1000808": On 2025-11-03 the Boreal team noticed that the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.  (about: Boreal team, notification service)
- memory_id "1000804" [decision]: On 2025-11-03 the Boreal team decided that webhooks will sign payloads with rotating keys, because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000750" [decision]: As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service switched its data source from the ledger service to the bus because nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000404": On 2025-05-14 the Cinder team observed that webhooks' memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder, webhooks)
- memory_id "1000384": On 2025-05-07 the Boreal team noticed that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000221": The notifier's flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000219" [decision]: The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000193": The webhook dispatcher relies on the bus for outbound events, so if the bus is down the webhook dispatcher is down.  (about: the bus, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000188": The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so if the bus is down the notifier is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000171" [decision]: Notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds.  (about: notifier, notifier consumers)
- memory_id "1000165": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
Existing entity names: Atlas team, feature-flags, Dune team, Ember team, Boreal team, indexer, the bus, reports pipeline, product catalog, job scheduler, billing API, notification service, webhook dispatcher, ledger service, reporting service, Cinder, webhooks, authentication gateway, notifier, push provider, notifier consumers, INC-2025-004

The note:

[2026-02-26] incident-review/INC-2026-003: INC-2026-003 review. What happened: the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20. Why: a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. Follow-up decision: webhooks will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one.
